# anthropic_telemetry_destinations (Data Source)

Lists the organization's OpenTelemetry telemetry destinations through the Admin API, newest first, with an optional filter by the workspaces they cover. This uses the Admin API beta `telemetry-destinations-2026-08-11`. Header values are write-only in the API, so only header names are exposed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_telemetry_destinations" "production" {
  workspace_ids = [anthropic_workspace.production.id]
}

output "disabled_telemetry_destinations" {
  value = [
    for destination in data.anthropic_telemetry_destinations.production.telemetry_destinations :
    destination.display_name
    if !destination.enabled
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `workspace_ids` (Set of String) Return only the destinations that cover at least one of these workspaces (`wrkspc_...`), at most 100. A destination covers a workspace when its `workspaces.type` is `all`, when its `include` list has the workspace, or when its `exclude` list does not. Destinations in either state can match. An ID that is not one of the organization's workspaces matches no destination.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier for this data source, derived from the configured filters.
- `telemetry_destinations` (Attributes List) The matching telemetry destinations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--telemetry_destinations))

<a id="nestedatt--telemetry_destinations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `telemetry_destinations`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of when the destination was created.
- `delivery_health` (Attributes) The most recent delivery results the API records for the destination. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--telemetry_destinations--delivery_health))
- `disabled_reason` (String) Why the destination is disabled: `caller`, `sustained_failure`, `invalid_address` or `redirect`. Null while the destination is enabled.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name of the destination. Null when none was set.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the destination receives deliveries.
- `endpoint_url` (String) The base URL of the destination's OTLP/HTTP endpoint, exactly as registered.
- `header_names` (Set of String) Names of the request headers registered on the destination. Values are never returned.
- `id` (String) ID of the telemetry destination (`tdst_...`).
- `traces` (Attributes) The destination's settings for the traces it receives. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--telemetry_destinations--traces))
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of the last change to the destination's configuration or state.
- `workspaces` (Attributes) Which of the organization's workspaces the destination covers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--telemetry_destinations--workspaces))

<a id="nestedatt--telemetry_destinations--delivery_health"></a>
### Nested Schema for `telemetry_destinations.delivery_health`

Read-Only:

- `last_error` (String) A message describing the most recent failed delivery. Null until a delivery first fails.
- `last_error_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of the failure `last_error` describes. Null until a delivery first fails.
- `last_success_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of the most recent successful delivery. Null until a delivery first succeeds.


<a id="nestedatt--telemetry_destinations--traces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `telemetry_destinations.traces`

Read-Only:

- `content_mode` (String) What the exported spans contain: `metadata_only` or `content`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the destination receives traces.
- `endpoint_url` (String) The full URL the API posts traces to. Null when the API posts to the destination's `endpoint_url` with `/v1/traces` appended.
- `max_content_bytes` (Number) The most bytes of content one exported span can contain. Null when only the API's maximum applies.


<a id="nestedatt--telemetry_destinations--workspaces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `telemetry_destinations.workspaces`

Read-Only:

- `type` (String) `all`, `include` or `exclude`.
- `workspace_ids` (Set of String) IDs of the workspaces on the destination's list. Null for `all` and for an empty list.
